description: The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable, and after two weeks of daily testing, it delivers the most meaningful shift in the iPhone experience in years. Its passport-style build, 5.4-inch outer screen, and 7.6-inch anti-glare nano-texture inner display make it remarkably versatile for reading, documents, and multitasking. Everyday performance and all-day battery life are rock solid, and the dual cameras produce clean, balanced shots. However, at Rs. 2,99,900, the absence of a telephoto lens, inconsistent third-party app scaling, and the step back to Touch ID are tough compromises. It’s an exceptional piece of hardware, but priced strictly for early adopters.
title: iPhone Duo Review: Brilliant Hardware, Astronomical Price Tag

description: Solana Foundation has acquired a majority stake in cryptocurrency data platform CoinGecko, although the financial terms and exact ownership share remain undisclosed. The agreement will introduce Solana-enabled trading across CoinGecko’s website, GeckoTerminal, and mobile app. The partnership also aims to expand market research, DeFi coverage, derivatives data, and tracking of tokenised real-world assets.
title: Solana Foundation Acquires Majority Stake in Crypto Data Platform CoinGecko

description: MEXC has announced the permanent discontinuation of its Global Card service from November 18, less than three months after its launch. The Visa-linked card allowed users to spend USDT through payment services such as Apple Pay and Google Pay. The exchange attributed the decision to changes by its third-party card issuer and has outlined how customers can recover their remaining balances.
title: MEXC Pulls the Plug on Visa-Linked Crypto Card Service Within Three Months After Launch

description: BSNL has introduced three prepaid recharge options for subscribers who need voice calls and SMS but do not use mobile data. Priced at Rs. 172, Rs. 184 and Rs. 190, the vouchers offer unlimited local, STD and roaming calls, along with 100 SMS per day. Their validity ranges from 28 days to a calendar month. The new recharges follow TRAI's mandate for standalone voice and SMS plans. BSNL also offers other voice-focused vouchers, while rival operators have similar recharge options.
title: BSNL Voice-Only Prepaid Plans With Unlimited Calls Launched in India: Price, Offers, Benefits

description: WhatsApp is reportedly testing a new way for Android users to react to messages using stickers from their personal collections. The feature adds a shortcut to the message menu, allowing users to access the sticker keyboard without opening the chat's sticker panel separately. Both animated and static stickers can be used, with up to 20 reactions reportedly allowed on a single message. The feature is currently said to be available to some beta testers, while a wider rollout is expected in the coming weeks.
title: WhatsApp Message Sticker Reactions Feature Reportedly Rolling Out to Android Beta Users

description: The Vivo Y05s has appeared on the Google Play Console Supported Devices List under model number V2668 and code number V2556. The latter is also associated with the Vivo Y05 4G, hinting that the upcoming smartphone could share hardware with the existing handset. If it is a rebranded model, the Vivo Y05s may feature a 120Hz LCD screen, an 8-megapixel rear camera and a 6,500mAh battery. Vivo has yet to confirm the specifications or announce its launch plans.
title: Vivo Y05s Google Play Console Listing Suggests It Could Be a Rebranded Vivo Y05 4G

description: After more than 13 years since the release of Grand Theft Auto V, Rockstar Games is finally bringing players the next mainline entry in its hugely popular open-world series. Grand Theft Auto VI is set to arrive today (November 19), taking players back to Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida. The game, however, will initially be limited to current-generation consoles, and its price, substantial storage requirement and lack of a PC version are worth knowing before launch.
title: GTA 6 Launches Tonight: India Release Time, Price, Platforms, Preload Details, and Everything You Need to Know

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has become the joint highest rated game of all time on Metacritic, with an aggregate score of 99. It is the first game to match the Metacritic score of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the Nintendo 64. Reviews hail the open world title as a "masterpiece". GTA 6 is set to launch on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Review Roundup: Rockstar's Open World Title Becomes Highest Rated Game of All Time

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 launch is almost here. The game will have a rolling midnight release across the globe on November 19. But PS5 and Xbox Series S/X users can play the game a few hours early by essentially changing their console's location to New Zealand, which will be the first region to get access to the game. Here's how you can do that.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Launch: How to Play the Game Early on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X at New Zealand Time

description: OnePlus Turbo 7 Pro is expected to launch in China in December alongside the standard Turbo 7 model.  OnePlus has not officially announced its launch date, but ahead of it, it has been spotted on China's 3C certification website with the model number PYP110. It could come with 100W charging speed.  It is tipped to feature a 185Hz display.
title: OnePlus Turbo 7 Pro Reportedly Clears China’s 3C Certification; Key Specifications Tipped

description: Google's cybersecurity research arm, Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG), has published its observations on how bad actors are abusing large language models (LLMs) to execute cyberattacks. According to GTIG’s evolution timeline for the use of LLMs by threat actors, the world is currently at Stage 5, where multiple attack lifecycles are executed by LLM-powered tools. The cybersecurity research group warns that in 1 to 3 months, the evolution cycle will reach Stage 6, where threat actors will start executing multi-agent-driven, unsophisticated cyberattacks with minimal human interaction. Lastly, Stage 7 is predicted to be 3 to 6 months away, where bad actors will be able to carry out sophisticated, fully autonomous cyberattacks by using AI agents.
title: Google Threat Intelligence Group Warns of Rise in Autonomous Cyberattacks by AI Agents by 2027

description: Apple's latest macOS beta introduces a revamped permission system that separates app control privileges from Accessibility permissions. Users can now grant Full Disk Access to specific folders, limit which apps another application can control, and require approval for access requests. The update also adds an indicator for apps controlling other software and retains previously approved permissions. Apple is making these changes amid growing concerns over AI agents accessing sensitive information, with the new privacy features currently available in macOS 27.3 beta 2.
title: Apple Adds More Granular App Permissions and Privacy Controls to macOS 27.3

description: Decentralised perpetual futures exchange Lighter has suspended withdrawals and liquidity pool creation following a suspected security incident involving two market maker accounts. On-chain investigators estimate losses of $15.48 million in USDC, with the attacker allegedly exploiting account permissions to move funds through a newly created liquidity pool. Lighter said it was investigating the incident and had taken precautionary measures.
title: Lighter Temporarily Blocks Withdrawals After Suspected $15.5 Million Crypto Attack

description: OpenAI launched GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol models. The former is intended for demanding work like creating presentations, spreadsheets and documents. It will also be used for coding, website development, gaming and 3D designs. GPT-6.2 Sol, on the other hand, is suitable for regular tasks and multi-step workflows. GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are available to Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users through ChatGPT Work and Codex.
title: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra, Sol AI Models Launched: Features, Availability and API Pricing

description: Samsung has begun rolling out the One UI 9.5 beta programme in India for its Galaxy S26 series. According to the South Korean tech conglomerate, the latest beta software update for its flagship lineup brings interface changes and new features, including a native app lock, proximity-based file sharing, and updated lock screen effects. India is among six countries included in the first wave of the One UI 9.5 beta rollout.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Gets One UI 9.5 Beta in India With App Lock, Mindful Note and Pro Video Modes

description: Siemens has launched its Eigen Engineering Agent in India, a purpose-built AI tool designed to handle automation engineering tasks. The system can perform PLC coding, HMI visualisation and device configuration within real engineering environments. Siemens says the agent has already been successfully piloted with more than 16 customers across India. It can complete AI-powered workflows two to five times faster than manual methods, with up to 80% higher solution quality and 50% greater engineering efficiency.
title: Can AI Run a Factory? Siemens Launches Eigen Engineering Agent in India

description: After introducing messaging capabilities within the Instagram app as ‘Instagram Direct’ back in 2013, Meta has now created and is testing a standalone messaging app called ‘Direct’ in select markets. The new app basically lets users message one another outside the Instagram app.
title: Meta Tests Instagram Direct App With Messaging Features for Users Without Instagram Accounts

description: Google is extending Gemini's task-handling capabilities beyond paid subscribers, allowing free users in several markets to delegate activities to the AI assistant. The update includes support for business calls, appointment bookings, shopping and grocery orders, along with integrations for Google Pay, Google Wallet and Instacart. Gemini can also help organise information from emails and handle requests through messaging. While the expanded capabilities are rolling out across several countries, RCS messaging and some other features remain limited to users in the US.
title: Google Gemini Tasks Rolls Out to Free Users in India: Here's What You Need to Know

description: Philips TAB4304/94 soundbar, Philips TAX2504/94 and Philips TAX2304/94 Bluetooth party speakers, and Philips TAX7404BK/94 portable Bluetooth speaker have been launched in India, the company announced on Wednesday. The Philips TAB4304/94 features two full-range drivers per left and right channel. The soundbar also sports a dual wired subwoofer system, with 5.25-inch woofers, which is claimed to offer deeper bass. It delivers a maximum output of 250W. The soundbar supports Bluetooth 5.4, HDMI-ARC, USB Audio Playback, AUX, and optical inputs for connectivity. The Philips TAB4304/94 also offers four sound modes.
title: Philips TAB4304/94 Soundbar and Three Bluetooth Speakers Launched in India: Price, Features
Get more done with Adobe Acrobat’s 25+ Free PDF Web Tools, No Sign-Ups Required to Try

description: Motorola Edge 70 Neo will launch in India next week, the company announced on Wednesday. The upcoming handset will debut as the latest addition to the Edge 70 lineup, which already includes the Edge 70, Edge 70 Pro, Edge 70 Pro+, Edge 70 Max, and Edge 70 Fusion. Alongside the launch date, the brand has also revealed several of its specifications. The Motorola Edge 70 Neo will be powered by a Snapdragon chipset. It is confirmed to pack a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo India Launch Date Announced; Key Features, Colour Options Revealed

description: The Game Awards 2026 nominees have been announced. Grand Theft Auto 6, which launches Novemver 19, leads with eight nominations, including Game of the Year. The game is up against Control Resonant, Resident Evil Requiem, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, Phantom Blade Zero, and 007 First Light for the night’s biggest honour.
title: The Game Awards 2026 Nominees Announced: GTA 6 Leads With 8 Nominations, Including Game of the Year

description: With the launch of its 18 Pro and K100 series out of the way, Xiaomi is now focussed on its mid-range Turbo series of smartphones. Previously leaked information points to the existence of two models – the Redmi Turbo 6 and the Redmi Turbo 6 Max. The series has now received radio certification in China, as it inches closer to its expected 2027 launch.
title: Redmi Turbo 6 Series Reportedly Gets China Certification Ahead of Expected 2027 Launch

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6), one of the most hyped and long-awaited video games of all time, is finally here. Players across the world, including India, will get their first chance to explore Vice City starting today (November 19). The game has been available for pre-order for several months, with Rockstar Games also allowing players to pre-download it from November 12. Now, those who have waited to get their hands on a physical copy can order GTA 6 through the quick-commerce platform Blinkit, which has started offering the PS5 version in select cities across the country.
title: GTA 6 Can Now Be Ordered on Blinkit in Select Indian Cities Ahead of Global Release Today

description: Xiaomi 18 could launch soon. Ahead of the formal reveal, it has surfaced in an alleged live image, revealing its rear design. The phone is tipped to feature a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip. It could come with a 200-megapixel camera and a 7,000mAh battery. It is said to feature a 6.4-inch LTPO OLED display with a 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate.
title: Xiaomi 18 Live Image Leaked Online; Tipped to Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Chipset, 7,000mAh Battery

description: Jensen Huang would be honoured to return as Nvidia's CEO if the Board of Directors approves, he said in his first public statement. Huang said that he is “overwhelmed” by the support extended by industry colleagues. Huang highlights that, since his exit, Nvidia “employees, investors, business partners, and customers” have been seeking his return as the CEO of the tech giant. “Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics,” Huang wrote. Further, the former Nvidia executive said that he would be “honoured” to resume the CEO position if the Board of Directors decides that it is “in the best interest of our shareholders, employees, the company, and America”.
title: Jensen Huang Says He Would Be ‘Honoured’ to Return as Nvidia CEO in First Public Statement After Exit

description: Samsung's next major software update could bring Android 17-based One UI 9.5 to a wide range of Galaxy devices, spanning flagship smartphones, foldables, tablets and several budget and mid-range models. The expected eligibility list includes devices from the Galaxy S, Z, A, M and F series, along with Galaxy Tab and XCover models. Samsung has not officially confirmed the list. The update is also tipped to bring interface changes, including a redesigned Phone app search button and additional Galaxy AI features.
title: Samsung One UI 9.5 Update Could Reach These Galaxy Phones and Tablets

description: Asus expanded its TUF Gaming portfolio in India on Wednesday with the launch of the refreshed TUF Gaming F16, Made in India TUF Gaming A15, and TUF Gaming T700 Mini desktop. According to the company, the new lineup is aimed at users looking for devices that can handle gaming, studies, and everyday productivity. The laptops feature MIL-STD-810H military-grade durability, expandable memory and storage, and upgraded cooling systems. The TUF Gaming F16 is powered by Intel Core 5 and Core 7 processors, while the A15 gets an AMD Ryzen 7 chipset and Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050 graphics.
title: Asus TUF Gaming F16 (2026), A15 (2026) Laptops and T700 Mini Desktop Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung may launch the Galaxy AI subscription soon. Users may need to upgrade to a paid Galaxy AI plan to create more than three Custom Cards. An updated entry on the Custom Card limits page suggests this. The Standard plan is reportedly expected to retain the existing limit of three cards. The leaked support page reportedly mentions that creating and editing Custom Cards consumes AI Plan credits.
title: Samsung Galaxy AI Paid Subscription May Offer More Now Brief Custom Cards: Report

description: iQOO 16 could be launched in India soon as a purported launch teaser of the handset has surfaced online. The purported iQOO 16 teaser also shows the phone with a square-shaped rear camera island, housing a triple camera system. The teaser features the tagline, “Next Monster Loading…”. Meanwhile, the leaker also writes, “Loading… 54 percent”, signalling that it could be launched in December, as more than half of November has passed. This is in line with a recent report, which suggested that the Vivo sub-brand is planning to launch the iQOO 16 next month. While the company has yet to confirm the launch timeline, the flagship iQOO 16 is confirmed to debut in the country soon.
title: iQOO 16 India Launch Seems Imminent as Debut Teaser Surfaces Online: Expected Specifications

description: Instagram on Tuesday announced a new content protection feature to help creators identify and manage unauthorised copies of their original videos. According to the Meta-owned social media platform, its new tool can automatically scan Instagram and Facebook for videos that visually match a creator's protected content and send alerts when it detects a potential match. The feature is available to eligible Instagram creators who meet Meta's originality and integrity requirements. Meta is also testing ways to identify AI-generated copies that reuse original audio.
title: Instagram Rolls Out Content Protection Feature to Help Creators Track and Claim Credit for Reposted Videos

description: Bitcoin recovered towards $65,000 as stronger-than-expected Nvidia earnings lifted sentiment across technology markets and spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a marginal return to inflows. However, contracting liquidity, cautious institutional participation, and expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike continue to limit the recovery. Investors are now watching upcoming Fed signals and Bitcoin's ability to reclaim $67,000.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $64,400 as Nvidia Earnings Offer Crypto Market Relief

description: Apple Maps update has started rolling out to users in India with new features and improvements. The update introduces more accurate navigation, comprehensive views, and more than 300 three-dimensional (3D) landmarks. The company also claims that the latest Apple Maps version gets multiple India-specific features, including improved Natural Language Guidance and dual-language labels. The enhanced Natural Language Guidance feature in Apple Maps is claimed to offer “directions that sound more conversational and are easier to follow”. The functionality has been enhanced to be “more useful and relevant” to India’s navigation needs with the addition of different “real-world details”, like pillars and other points of interest, that could help users find ways along roads that might not have an assigned name.
title: Apple Maps in India Gets Updated With Improved Navigation, 3D Landmarks and More

description: Alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro models, the Chinese brand also announced a bunch of wearables including its Watch S5 and the Smart Band 11. Also announced were the new Xiaomi Clip buds, which are expected to be a premium take on the Redmi Clip Neo.
title: Xiaomi Clip Launched Globally With Bone Conduction Mics, 11mm Dynamic Driver and Hi-Res Audio: Price, Features

description: Dell's new Pro headset range includes wired and wireless options across three series, with prices starting at Rs. 5,141. The Pro 3 and Pro 5 models offer different driver sizes, microphone configurations and noise cancellation features, while the Pro 7 Wireless ANC stands out with a boomless 10-microphone system and AI Conversation Focus. Wireless battery life varies by model, reaching up to 115 hours on the Pro 7 with ANC disabled. The Pro 7 will go on sale in February 2027.
title: Dell Pro 3, Pro 5 and Pro 7 Headsets Launched in India: Price, Features

description: WhatsApp is said to be testing a new cloud backup option for iPhone users in beta. According to a feature tracker, the capability would allow them to store their chat history on the messaging platform's own servers instead of relying exclusively on Apple's iCloud service. The report mentions that the in-development feature provides WhatsApp users with another option for managing their chat backups, especially those running short on iCloud storage.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Tests Letting iPhone Users Back Up Chats Without Using iCloud

description: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm was launched in global markets on Tuesday alongside the NFC variant of the Xiaomi Smart Band 11. The smartwatch has a 1.32-inch AMOLED display with 3,000 nits of peak brightness. It carries a 590mAh battery and offers up to 14 days of battery life. The Xiaomi Smart Band 11 NFC has a 1.72-inch AMOLED touch display with a resolution of 212 x 520 pixels.
title: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm Launched With 1.32-inch AMOLED Display, Xiaomi Smart Band 11 NFC Tags Along

description: Google has announced its Google Play Best of 2026 winners in India. Editing platform Adobe Premiere was selected as Best App of 2026. ibis Paint X won the Best for Creative Expression category. Arknights: Endfield emerged as one of the biggest winners in the gaming categories, securing both the Best Game and Best Story awards
title: Google Play Best Apps and Games of 2026 in India Announced: Adobe Premiere, Pronto Win Top Awards
